lines: Tattha suṇisāti puttassa bhariyā.
Itthiyā hi sāmikassa pitā “sasuro”ti vuccati, tassa ca sā “suṇisā”ti.
Taṃ sandhāya “suṇisā ahosiṃ sasurassa gehe”ti.
Bhāgaḍḍhabhāganti attanā laddhapaṭivīsato upaḍḍhabhāgaṃ.
Modāmi nandane vaneti therena nandanavane diṭṭhatāya āha.
Sesaṃ vuttanayameva.

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Abhikkantena vaṇṇenāti suṇisāvimānaṃ.
Tassa kā uppatti?

Sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarasmiṃ gehe ekā kulasuṇhā gehaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhaṃ khīṇāsavattheraṃ disvā sañjātapītisomanassā “idaṃ mayhaṃ uttamaṃ puññakkhettaṃ upaṭṭhitan”ti attanā laddhaṃ pūvabhāgaṃ ādāya ādarena therassa upanesi, thero taṃ paṭiggahetvā anumodanaṃ katvā gato.
Sā aparabhāge kālaṃ katvā tāvatiṃsabhavane uppajji.
Sesaṃ sabbaṃ heṭṭhā vuttasadisameva.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Abhikkantena vaṇṇena, yā tvaṃ tiṭṭhasi devate;

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Obhāsentī disā sabbā, osadhī viya tārakā.

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Kena tetādiso vaṇṇo, kena te idha mijjhati;

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Uppajjanti ca te bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Pucchāmi taṃ devi mahānubhāve, manussabhūtā kimakāsi puññaṃ;

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvā, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Sā devatā attamanā, moggallānena pucchitā;

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Pañhaṃ puṭṭhā viyākāsi, yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ”.

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūtā, suṇisā ahosiṃ sasurassa gehe.

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Addasaṃ virajaṃ bhikkhuṃ, vippasannamanāvilaṃ;

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Tassa adāsahaṃ pūvaṃ, pasannā sehi pāṇibhi;

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Bhāgaḍḍhabhāgaṃ datvāna, modāmi nandane vane.

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo, tena me idha mijjhati;

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Uppajjanti ca me bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Akkhāmi te bhikkhu mahānubhāva, manussabhūtā yamakāsi puññaṃ;

before.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Tenamhi evaṃ jalitānubhāvā, vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.

after.title: Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Suṇisāvimānavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā.
